Read and follow, in order:
- context/CLAUDE.md     (what an AI collaborator may and may not do)
- context/STANDARDS.md  (code conventions)
- context/DESIGN.md     (tokens, if present; use names, never raw values)

When a request touches a feature, read its rows in context/FEATURES.md first.
Never place an API key or secret in client code. Never edit files in context/ without being asked.
